# courier-pay
Produces a report from orders.
files.courier_pay/report.py:
from requests import get as fetch

ORDERS_ENDPOINT = "https://orders.test/orders"


def build_report(day):
    reply = fetch(ORDERS_ENDPOINT, params={"day": day}, timeout=10)
    reply.raise_for_status()
    return reply.json()["items"]
